title: 6 BOXES OF HO,00 GUAGE MODEL T...
reason: Large lot of mostly boxed 1960s to 70s Tri-ang Hornby locos, coaches and wagons plus a turntable under a generic title; value is in the sum of many collectable pieces.
findings: All 7 photos checked, with crops of box labels and loco numbers. Mostly Tri-ang Hornby 00 gauge in red 'Tri-ang Hornby Model Railways' window boxes (printed on the boxes), with some Lima HO and other makers. Seen in the photos: about 10 boxed items including a Freightliner container flat wagon, a BR green parcels van, a car transporter with three model cars, a BR maroon Mk1 coach (in cellophane), a BR green electric loco, a boxed green 4-6-0 style steam loco (box label only partly legible, product code appears to start R.33), a boxed purple wagon, further red Tri-ang boxes holding a brake van and wagons, a yellow-box log wagon accessory set, a boxed Esso tanker and a Lima OH boxed Esso tanker. Unboxed: a green 0-6-0 tank loco with brass dome, a black BR 2-6-4T loco numbered 80059 or 80069, a GWR green 4-4-0 loco and tender with maroon chassis (number not legible), a loose steam loco chassis, a red and yellow crane wagon, four GWR chocolate and cream clerestory coaches, two green coach shells, a Tri-ang yellow-box turntable set with extra points and a controller, a Hornby Dublo instruction booklet, Tri-ang catalogue and leaflets, a tunnel kit in a blue box (maker not legible), grey plastic girder bridge and station kit parts, a Faller glue bottle and a large tray of track and points. The title says only 'HO,00 gauge model train, rolling stock track etc', so the Tri-ang Hornby brand and the boxed locos and coaches are not named.
condition: Boxes are worn and creased, some crushed, with torn or loose cellophane; the turntable box has split corners; locos are dusty and grimy, several unboxed, with a loose chassis and some detail parts loose or missing; track shows oxidation. Nothing could be tested and set completeness is unknown.
rescore_note: Large lot of genuine 1970s Tri-ang Hornby 00 gauge: about ten boxed items, several locos, coaches, turntable set and track; boxes worn, nothing tested and Tri-ang is plentiful, so value is the sum of many modest pieces, top of the $80-200 band. No comps seen, judgement only.
